_comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.3, extended Task 2.4): THE canonical for `horns_dig` AND the door chain's start, played live end-to-end from the horns_dig_start fixture -- Ceria's invitation AT THE INN (the new ceria_intro attachment on ceria_inn, reached through her talk_pool the erin/pisces/krshia way: first interact = a pool line, second = the graph), the ruin seam opening on its NEW gate (horns_dig_started, not the retired door_chain_started), the camp join at ruin_surface's ceria_dig_camp, the FIGHT leg of the breach (ruin_guardian, Relc fielded off met_relc), the shipped rune pair, and the reveal. Nothing is pre-banked: every counter this script asserts is earned in-run. EXTENDED in Task 2.4 through the whole main-quest opening: the haul comes home, Pisces hangs it at the pantry (data/dialogue/door_mounting.json on inn.json's `pisces_mounting` NPC), door_mounted closes the haul beat and COMPLETES horns_dig, the same option auto-starts door_that_goes_elsewhere (the reshaped chain has no start option -- this conversation IS its start), and the run ends by riding the Magical Door to Liscor for real off the new day-one portal gate. That makes this THE canonical main-quest-start proof for the wave: from 'heard your team's digging' to a working Door, with nothing pre-banked. Teleports cover only stretches already proven live elsewhere (inn->floodplains by inn_walkthrough/gate_district_walkthrough, the ruin interior by ruin_walkthrough); the ruin_door transition itself is walked for real because its gate is what changed. Fixture rng_state governs the one fight.

payload_contains.speaker: Ceria
payload_contains.text: It was guarding a door. Wonderful. Somebody left a construct in the dark to watch one door, and we still don't know what's on the other side.

steps._comment: Visible options are ['Heard your team's digging east of the gate road.', 'Understood.'] -- 'Go on.' is hidden by horns_party_formed. The cursor starts on the invitation, so confirm takes it with no cursor move.

payload_contains.speaker: Ceria
payload_contains.text: Word travels. Yes — there's a ruin out past the floodplains, and under it a level nobody's opened since before Liscor had walls. We hit the seal three days ago. Yvlon can't cut it, and the one mage in this city who could read it works for himself and charges accordingly. We need one more pair of hands.

steps._comment: == v0.15 T4.3 round 2: THE DIALOGUE DEFER, proven at the seam it was built for. The option just taken banked horns_dig_started and went on to dig_pitch, and that counter retires ceria_inn/yvlon_inn/ksmvr_inn (all three on screen, the speaker among them). Before the defer, world.gd reconciled presence on the bank and popped them mid-sentence -- VISUAL-LOG RUIN/CAMP-DOUBLE. Take the SECOND branch first (What's down there? -> dig_unknown) so the pitch's other arm is covered, then rejoin dig_directions from it.

payload_contains.speaker: Ceria
payload_contains.text: If I knew, I wouldn't need a dig. Whatever it is, someone sealed it on purpose and did a very good job. Usually that means valuable or it means dangerous. I plan the camp for dangerous.

payload_contains.speaker: Ceria
payload_contains.text: East past the gate road, across the floodplains — follow the survey stakes. Ask for me at the camp. And bring your own rope.

steps._comment: == THE FLUSH, exactly once. DIALOGUE_ENDED drains the queued reconcile in a single rebuild: 21 -> 18, the three Horns gone together, and the whole-run count is now 2 (boot + flush), not 2-per-bank. ==

steps._comment: == TRAVEL: the ruin seam on its NEW gate ==. Teleport to (37,11) on the floodplains -- the ruin_walkthrough approach cell, one west of ruin_door (38,11) -- then bump east into the door's own (blocked) cell for facing and interact. door_chain_started is NOT banked in this fixture: if the gate had stayed on it, this interact would fall through to the inert 'It doesn't feel like it goes anywhere. Yet.' toast and the run would die here.

payload_contains.text: The seam splits wider at your touch, cold air breathing out of the dark beneath. You step through, into somewhere else.

steps._comment: The re-gated arrival toast: it now fires off horns_dig_started (was door_understood) and names the camp, so the ruin reads as occupied the moment you land.

payload_contains.text: East past the gate road, across the floodplains — this is the ruin. Survey stakes, a banked fire, and someone's washing on a line: the Horns got here first. The sealed level is deeper in, under the pedestal court.

steps._comment: == THE CAMP ==. (2,2) -> (4,2) along the clear top row, then bump south into ceria_dig_camp (4,3). The camp has no talk_pool, so the FIRST interact opens its graph.

payload_contains.speaker: Ceria
payload_contains.text: You made it. Camp rules: nobody touches anything shiny, nobody wanders past the survey stakes alone. The sealed level's below the pedestal court. We found the site off an old expedition ledger — half the pages are about what they didn't bring out. It's in my tent, filed with the survey maps.

steps._comment: Option 0 = "Let's open it up." (visible: horns_dig_joined still 0) banks the join and closes the join_dig beat -> beat_index 1 (breach). payload_contains.text: Ceria plans it, Ksmvr measures it, I hold the part that's about to fall. That's the arrangement.
The string is taut. Somebody re-tensions it each morning, which is not a thing four adventurers usually bother to do.

payload_contains.speaker: Ksmvr
payload_contains.text: Sixty-one strides of rope. I have counted it four times. The number has not improved. I am accounting for that.

payload_contains.text: The seal is broken and the Horns are already down the gap — Yvlon bracing, Ksmvr counting rope. The warding still holds the stone fast. Two spiral plates flank the court; Ceria points at the carving beside the pedestal and says that one's a beginning.

All three contains_when counters (pedestal_unsealed, rune_sequence_done, horns_dig_joined) are now met live, so the container opens and its ARRAY on_open_accomplishment banks the convergent set in order: recovered_anchor_stone, pedestal_breached (which closes the breach beat -> beat_index 2, haul), door_retrieved. open_toast speaks LAST, after both pickups' own 'Got:' lines -- so the reveal is the final thing on screen.

payload_contains.text: Below the pedestal: not treasure. A DOOR — unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.

But push it unattuned and things we did not invite will leak through. So we attune it properly. Krshia stocks the catalysts, and I have already started on the calculations for our half of the work.
